**Finding: compliant** — no redline needed.

The agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Sparkling:

- **§ 3 (Restrictions on Use)** is confined to ordinary licence-scope limits on the Software/Documentation (backup-only copying, no reverse engineering, no sublicence/transfer, no service-bureau use of the Work). These restrict how the licensed Software is used, not what businesses we operate or what routing products we may purchase or build.
- **§ 19 (Non-Solicitation of Employees)** is a mutual, one-year employee non-solicit — a personnel covenant, not a restrictive covenant on our business.
- **§ 20 / Page 10 (General Matters)** contains only boilerplate (notices, waiver, assignment, independent contractors, force majeure, severability, governing law).
- Searches for "compet", "develop", "exclusiv" and "shall not" surfaced no competing-products, territory, or field-of-use covenant binding our party.

This matches the playbook preferred position (no non-compete on Customer), so no fallback narrowing is necessary.
